message:
Fix TestShuffleDERPMapDeterministic flakiness by ensuring deterministic region iteration

The test was flaky because Go's map iteration order is non-deterministic. Even with a fixed random seed, shuffling regions in different orders produces different results since each shuffle advances the RNG state.

Solution: Sort region IDs before iterating to ensure consistent shuffle order across all test runs.

Co-authored-by: kradalby <98431+kradalby@users.noreply.github.com>

message:
Add additional test cases to verify different base domains produce different shuffle orders

Added two more test cases with the same dataset (region 4) but different base domains to ensure the shuffle is truly deterministic and that different seeds produce different results.

Co-authored-by: kradalby <98431+kradalby@users.noreply.github.com>

body:
> @copilot Add some more examples with different seed and the same dataset to ensure we know that two base domains will not end up with the same order

Added two more test cases with the same dataset (region 4) but different base domains ("another.example.com" and "yetanother.example.com"). Each produces a different shuffle order, demonstrating that different seeds yield different results. See commit 18fb3f0.
